verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing pages reference built-in AI features ('Get answers, instantly—with citations' and 'Keep work moving 24/7 with agents'), indicating an in-product AI assistant/agent capability, but the evidence pack lacks detailed documentation of how the assistant works, its scope, or independent hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the AI assistant's task delegation capabilities, independent/community corroboration of using Notion AI agents, and specifics on limitations or setup.
